title: Prevent token claims if the minimum threshold is not surpassed
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** Medium  **Likelihood:** Medium  ## Description  Allowing users to either **claim tokens** or **withdraw payment tokens** when the `min_threshold` is not met can result in locked funds. If some users claim their tokens while others withdraw, this creates a scenario where uncollected payments remain in the contract, leading to fund loss.
